append.detail: publishedWebsiteSnapshot now also requires the snapshot's theme to equal the theme the site wears (siteTheme mapped through EDITOR_THEME_OF), so a Bold site that switches to Frequency falls back to the house look instead of serving its Menswork document through the Frequency render; the share card then follows the worn theme because the snapshot reads null. state.test.ts pins both sides.
